            setattr(cls, 'get_%s_display' % self.name,
                    partialmethod(cls._get_FIELD_display, field=self))
"""
new = """        if self.choices is not None:
            # Don't override a get_FOO_display() method defined explicitly on
            # this class, but don't check methods inherited from the
            # superclass.
            if 'get_%s_display' % self.name not in cls.__dict__:
                setattr(cls, 'get_%s_display' % self.name,
                        partialmethod(cls._get_FIELD_display, field=self))
"""
assert old in s, 'target block not found'
open(p, 'w').write(s.replace(old, new))
print('patched')
EOF

import django
from django.conf import settings
settings.configure(
    INSTALLED_APPS=['django.contrib.contenttypes', 'django.contrib.auth'],
    DATABASES={},
    USE_TZ=False,
)
django.setup()
from django.db import models


class FooBar(models.Model):
    foo_bar = models.CharField(max_length=10, choices=[(1, 'foo'), (2, 'bar')])

    def __str__(self):
        return self.get_foo_bar_display()

    def get_foo_bar_display(self):
        return 'something'

    class Meta:
        app_label = 'auth'


class Plain(models.Model):
    foo_bar = models.CharField(max_length=10, choices=[(1, 'foo'), (2, 'bar')])

    class Meta:
        app_label = 'auth'


class Sub(FooBar):
    class Meta:
        app_label = 'auth'
        proxy = True


print('override ->', FooBar(foo_bar=1).get_foo_bar_display())
print('default  ->', Plain(foo_bar=1).get_foo_bar_display())
print('proxy    ->', Sub(foo_bar=2).get_foo_bar_display())
assert FooBar(foo_bar=1).get_foo_bar_display() == 'something'
assert Plain(foo_bar=1).get_foo_bar_display() == 'foo'
assert Plain(foo_bar=2).get_foo_bar_display() == 'bar'
assert Sub(foo_bar=1).get_foo_bar_display() == 'something'
print('REPRO OK')
EOF
